sources.title: ai-summarizer · GitHub Topics · GitHub
sources.snippet: The main goal of an AI-Powered News Summarizer is to assist users in quickly understanding the main points and essential information from a large volume of news articles or textual content. By automatically summarizing news articles, it saves time and effort by providing users with a brief overview without having to read the entire article.
